name: unsafe fn from_raw_parts (buf : * mut u8 , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> String
rule: After String::from_raw_parts(buf, length, capacity) is called, nothing else may use buf; ownership has transferred to the returned String, which may deallocate, reallocate, or change the pointed-to memory.
api: impl  alloc::string::String { unsafe fn from_raw_parts (buf : * mut u8 , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> alloc::string::String }
